title: End of Dynasty 12 (death of Sobekneferu)
summary: CFAH AP-52: Dynasty 12 ended with the death of Sobekneferu, 1526/1525 BC.
description: CFAH-6 Argument 2: "a triangulation forming new Anchor Point #52, the End of Dynasty 12 in 1526/1525 BC". CFAH-6 Argument 4 §12-13 identifies Sobekneferu as the barren queen who raised Moses and Moses as Amenemhat IV.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #52; Argument 2 "Dynasty 12"
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "Death of R. Iubass, Sobekneferu, end of Dynasty 12"
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
